headline: Faster machine takes third, pushing Turducken off the podium

sections.heading: A second leap into third
sections.text: faster machine is all you need has taken third on ARC-AGI-3 at 58.59, ahead of Team Turducken at 56.02. The same entry, team 15487093, appeared as Xz in this morning’s wire after jumping to fourth at 52.95. Its later rise to 58.59 changes the podium again: Turducken slips from third at the previous close to fourth without changing its score. The team name supplies no evidence about its hardware or method.

sections.heading: The leaders still have room
sections.text: Yi-Chia Chen @ Fields Model holds first at 75.56, with Tufa Labs second at 70.02. The new third-place score remains well behind both. The Last Dance holds 51.51 in fifth, narrowly ahead of yktori at 51.04 and mtg at 50.37. NVARC3 is eighth at 49.54. For this group, faster machine’s advance is a reminder that an unchanged score can still lose a place.

sections.heading: The climb below the leaders
sections.text: Fighting Gold finishes 38th at 36.46, up 97 places and 3.05 points since the previous close. Earlier wire windows also recorded Rvldfr’s rise to 75th and MN Kaggler’s rise to 87th; those were observed moves at their stated times, rather than closing ranks. The midday wire’s gold-line story showed Nhan Duc Nguyen and Advaith Vecham falling outside the public gold places on unchanged scores. Public medal places remain provisional. Social and discussion research was not refreshed for this edition.
